value.name: Miles watches television in bed
value.description: Miles lies alone in bed reading while Court TV plays in the background.
evidence: Miles alone in bed, reading Art In America.
We hear Court TV on in the background.

value.name: Miles imagines violent courtroom revenge
value.description: Miles slips into a surreal fantasy in which he shoots several people, including Marylin, before hesitating.
evidence: Miles shoots -- Bonnie falls. Then Mrs. Guttman. Marylin is next. Miles hesitates.
Miles points the gun at Herb.

value.name: Phone rings and interrupts Miles
value.description: A ringing phone breaks into Miles's bed scene and startles him awake from the fantasy.
evidence: Miles BEDROOM He bolts up in bed, sweating.

value.name: Miles wakes in a sweat
value.description: Miles jolts upright, visibly sweating and disoriented after the disturbing dream or reverie.
evidence: He bolts up in bed, sweating.

value.name: Miles reaches for the phone
value.description: Miles reaches toward the ringing phone, preparing to answer an incoming call.
